rows.assessment: Configuration/workflow events are audited; no complete per-document old/new deadline ledger or pause/extension reasons.

rows.requirement: Record document and attachment deletion attempts.
rows.assessment: Successful document deletes are audited; denied deletion attempts and attachment deletion are not comprehensively recorded.

rows.requirement: Record administrative actions and security events.
rows.assessment: Sign-in failures/success and admin changes are logged.
Searchable audit endpoint/UI exists, capped to a recent window.

rows.requirement: Allow authorized export of audit reports.
rows.assessment: Authorized UI supports audit CSV/print; API exposes audit to audit.view users.

rows.requirement: Prevent ordinary users from editing or deleting audit records.
rows.assessment: Ordinary users have no audit edit/delete endpoint; administrator restore can replace audit data.

rows.requirement: Restrict and log access to sensitive records.
rows.assessment: No sensitive classification/access log model.
Salted scrypt password hashing and authenticated login exist; this is not a comprehensive security certification.
Action/stage authorization exists; confidential/division record-view authorization does not.

rows.requirement: Protection against SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and cross-site request forgery where applicable.
rows.assessment: Prepared SQL, HTML escaping, CSP and custom-header CSRF checks exist; CSV formula safety and broader attack coverage still need work.

rows.requirement: Input validation on both client and server.
rows.assessment: Validation exists, but restore nested data and some action-field consistency are incomplete.
Random session tokens are hashed in SQLite and cookies are HttpOnly/SameSite with optional Secure.

rows.requirement: Rate limiting and login attempt controls.
rows.assessment: Failed-login throttling exists; no general API/IP rate limiter and login keys are held in memory.
HTTPS reverse-proxy deployment is supported; actual certificate, network exposure and proxy configuration were not verified.

rows.requirement: Encryption for sensitive data at rest where appropriate.
rows.assessment: No application database encryption; host disk encryption was not inspected.

rows.requirement: Secure attachment handling and file type validation.
rows.assessment: No managed attachment processing/type validation.
JSON request size caps exist; they are not attachment upload size limits.

rows.requirement: Protection against unauthorized direct file access.
rows.assessment: Static serving uses an explicit allowlist; external file access is controlled by the external host, not DTS.
No confidential-record restrictions.
Idle and absolute session expiration exist.
Successful/failed sign-ins and related security/admin events are logged.
No third-party app dependencies; no automated Node/container/browser vulnerability/update process is provided.

rows.requirement: Data retention and authorized disposal policies.
rows.assessment: No retention/disposal policy engine.

rows.requirement: Privacy notice and appropriate personal-data handling.
rows.assessment: No privacy-notice screen found; agency personal-data policy/procedures were not supplied or assessed.
No documented incident response or tested disaster recovery runbook.
VACUUM INTO database backup runs at startup and daily; fourteen copies are retained.
Externally linked files are not copied/backed up.
JSON round-trip tests exist; automated daily SQLite snapshot verification is absent and malformed restore can persist invalid state.
Authorized JSON backup download exists.
JSON database restore exists; no attachment recovery or complete disaster-recovery procedure.
Retention is hard-coded to fourteen files; no setting.
README advises off-machine copies, but no automated off-device backup implementation exists.
healthz checks server response; no disk-space/storage monitoring.

rows.requirement: Database connection and application error logs.
rows.assessment: Server writes console errors; no durable structured log/diagnostic viewer.
Special Report schedule generation issues are stored/shown; no generalized failed-job or notification monitor.
Backup export/restore audit events exist; normal report/file exports and general imports lack a history model.
Divisions, reference types, holidays, designations, leave types and Special Report schedules are managed.
Accounts and role permission grants are managed; fixed role names and duplicate-username race remain limitations.

rows.requirement: Configurable document types, priorities, and statuses.
rows.assessment: Types are configurable; priority set and operational statuses are fixed.
Holidays are configurable; working weekdays are fixed to Monday-Friday.
Prefix is configurable; year/counter structure is fixed.
package.json version and engineering notes exist; no user-facing deployment/update history.
No maintenance switch or staged deployment/rollback system.
JSON backups include settings; recovery still has the validation defect.
No CSV/Excel import templates.
Restore shows counts/confirmation, not row-level import preview.
No import column mapping.
Mandatory/relationship validation exists in selected endpoints; no incoming document duplicate detector and restore validation is incomplete.
No row-level import error report.

rows.requirement: Import history and rollback where feasible.
rows.assessment: Backup restore is audited and SQL writes use a transaction; no general import rollback/history tool, and post-commit load can fail.
Batch options are forward/release/delete/print/CSV; staff assignment remains per document.
No bulk document-type/category update.
No archive lifecycle or bulk archive.
Filtered/selected records export as CSV.
Hidden columns do not change fixed CSV export columns.

rows.requirement: Export attachments as a controlled ZIP package, if needed.
rows.assessment: No attachment ZIP export.

rows.requirement: Backup and restore of reference/master data.
rows.assessment: Reference/master data are included in JSON backup/restore.

rows.requirement: Migration utilities from the existing DTS.
rows.assessment: Automatic compatibility upgrades and JSON restore exist; no cross-system migration/import wizard.
Selected checks/tests exist; no explicit post-migration integrity validation report.

rows.requirement: Stable identifiers that remain unchanged when a document is renamed or moved.
rows.assessment: Record IDs remain stable across ordinary metadata/routing changes.

rows.requirement: Responsive layout for desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile.
rows.assessment: Responsive styles and prior browser checks cover desktop/mobile widths; not rerun in this checklist review.
Shared sidebar navigation is consistent and permission-aware.
Header metadata search exists.
A back-to-dashboard link exists; no hierarchical breadcrumb trail.
Status/deadline/priority badges exist.
Dense tables with responsive containment are implemented.

rows.requirement: Resizable columns and configurable column visibility.
rows.assessment: Column visibility is saved; draggable/resizable column widths are absent.
Table header CSS is sticky.
Filters/sort survive within UI session; named/persisted filter and sort presets are absent.
Pagination and 25/50/100-row controls exist.
Document detail uses stacked cards/history rather than tabbed detail sections.
Lifecycle and movement timeline exist.
Contextual action panels and batch/toolbar actions exist.
Keyboard shortcut handler and help modal exist.

rows.requirement: Confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions.
rows.assessment: Delete/restore/batch actions confirm; some consequential individual transitions do not universally confirm.
Workflow designer warns on unsaved changes; ordinary document forms lack a general dirty-form warning/autosave.

rows.requirement: Loading, empty, success, and error states.
rows.assessment: Splash/retry, loading, empty-state, toast and error displays exist.
Shared formatters exist; client uses its local timezone while server defaults to Asia/Manila, so cross-timezone consistency is not guaranteed.

rows.requirement: Accessible color contrast and keyboard navigation.
rows.assessment: Labels, native controls and shortcuts exist; no comprehensive contrast/keyboard accessibility audit was supplied.
Automatic/light/dark themes exist.
Agency image assets and configurable organization name exist; logo replacement is a file edit, not an upload setting.
Routing slips, tables, reports, graphs and schedules have print views.

rows.requirement: Excel export as the primary data extraction feature where preferred.
rows.assessment: CSV is the extraction format and can be opened in Excel; native XLSX is absent.

rows.requirement: User preferences for table density and default landing page.
rows.assessment: No density/default-landing-page preference.

rows.requirement: Automatically assign documents based on document type or originating office.
rows.assessment: Configured reporting-period document types route by region/office designation; arbitrary rule-based auto-assignment is absent.

rows.requirement: Automatically calculate deadlines based on configurable rules.
rows.assessment: Configured deadline rules calculate dates.
Ordinary tracking numbers are generated automatically; Special Report display-number uniqueness needs correction.

rows.requirement: Automatically notify the next responsible person after forwarding.
rows.assessment: The next actor's queue/bell updates; no persistent event notification or delivery.
No escalation engine.
No scheduled pending-document digest.

rows.requirement: Automatically flag documents missing mandatory attachments.
rows.assessment: No required-attachment model/validator.
No follow-up task creation.
Routing slips are generated on demand; no automatic transmittal numbering/sheet job.

rows.requirement: Automatically update dashboard counts after transactions.
rows.assessment: Mutations refresh state and other sessions poll version changes about every fifteen seconds.

rows.requirement: Automatically archive eligible completed records, subject to policy.
rows.assessment: No automatic archive/retention job.

rows.requirement: Automatically remind users about documents awaiting their action.
rows.assessment: Queue and due-soon indicators exist; no active scheduled reminders.
Special Reports generate on configured recurring schedules with catch-up and uniqueness constraints.

rows.requirement: Automatically flag unusual inactivity or repeated returns.
rows.assessment: Admin/Focal stalled thresholds and revision cycle counts exist; no generalized inactivity/repeated-return anomaly rules.

rows.requirement: Provide configurable rules for exceptional situations.
rows.assessment: OIC/override/resubmission/reference rules exist; designer conditions do not execute production workflows.

rows.requirement: Internal discussion threads attached to documents.
rows.assessment: Timestamped notes and reviewer comments exist; no nested threaded discussions.
No mentions or mention notifications.

rows.requirement: Private internal notes separated from official correspondence.
rows.assessment: Notes are separate from the external file, but have no private visibility tier.
Staff/workload views share document action lists; no independent shared task-list objects.
Team/staff workload reports and charts exist.
Manager present/away flags and personnel leave calendar exist; staff leave is not automatically integrated into routing availability.

rows.requirement: Delegation during leave or official travel.
rows.assessment: Manual manager/OIC delegation exists; no general timed staff substitution linked to leave.
No follow-up reminder scheduler.
No linked related-document records.
No team announcement module.

rows.requirement: Handover notes when an employee leaves or changes assignment.
rows.assessment: Reassignment accepts a note; no structured employee departure/handover record.

rows.requirement: Activity feed showing recent team actions.
rows.assessment: Authorized audit/history can show actions; no separate recent team activity feed.

rows.requirement: Comments with timestamps and author identity.
rows.assessment: Comments/history include actor and timestamp.
No instruction acknowledgment/read receipt.

rows.requirement: Google Drive links or API integration.
rows.assessment: Drive URLs can be stored; no authenticated Drive API integration.
No SMTP integration.

rows.requirement: LDAP or Active Directory authentication, if available.
rows.assessment: No directory/LDAP authentication.
No agency SSO/OIDC/SAML integration.

rows.requirement: Microsoft Office document preview or conversion.
rows.assessment: No native Office conversion/preview integration.
CSV opens in Excel; native XLSX generation is absent.

rows.requirement: QR code generation for physical documents.
rows.assessment: No QR generation.
No barcode scan input workflow.
No scanner integration.

rows.requirement: Calendar integration for deadlines and reminders.
rows.assessment: Personnel calendar is implemented; document-deadline calendar/sync/reminders are absent.
No e-signature integration.

rows.requirement: Internal API for future agency systems.
rows.assessment: Internal cookie-authenticated APIs exist; no published service API/auth contract for other agency systems.
No event webhooks.
No OCR service.

rows.requirement: Export to existing departmental reporting templates.
rows.assessment: Generic reports/routing slips exist; no agency template import/mapping/export integration.
No OCR/content extraction/index.
No version comparison tool.
Manual classification only; no AI suggestions.
Workload, desk-age and return-cycle indicators exist; no historical process mining or automatic workload balancing.
Only literal metadata search.
No file metadata/text extraction.
No content hash or similarity duplicate detection.
No generated response suggestions.
No document summarization.
Simple Admin/Focal stall thresholds exist; no statistical/anomaly model.
No predicted completion-date model.

rows.requirement: Indexed database columns for common searches.
rows.assessment: IDs and workflow/report lookup indexes exist; ordinary searchable document metadata is JSON and is searched in browser memory.

rows.requirement: Efficient server-side filtering, sorting, and pagination.
rows.assessment: Ordinary document filtering/sorting/pagination happen in the browser after downloading state.
Graph/report/restore operations use SQL transactions; ordinary document mutation, sequence and audit writes are not one combined transaction.

rows.requirement: Prevention of duplicate submissions and conflicting updates.
rows.assessment: Workflow drafts have revision conflict checks and recurring reports have unique keys; ordinary updates lack general revision/idempotency protection and user creation has a confirmed race.
Workflow foreign keys and recurring-report uniqueness exist; many user/document/division references inside JSON have no database constraints.

rows.requirement: Background jobs for scheduled reports and bulk processing.
rows.assessment: In-process timers generate recurring reports; no durable worker queue or bulk-processing job system.
Console error logging exists; no centralized persistent error service/view.
healthz exists; no uptime monitor/alerts.
No resumable/interrupted upload handling; binary uploads are absent.

rows.requirement: File size and storage usage monitoring.
rows.assessment: No storage usage/file-size monitor.
CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and compatibility upgrades exist; no numbered migration ledger.

rows.requirement: Automated tests for workflow transitions and permissions.
rows.assessment: API regression tests cover document rules, roles, fallback/OIC, schedules and designer behavior.
Concurrent requests are tested; independent simultaneous user-session soak testing is absent.
JSON restore round trips are tested; full snapshot disaster recovery and malformed restore rejection are incomplete.
No failed-deployment rollback/recovery runbook.

rows.requirement: Separation of development, testing, and production environments.
rows.assessment: DATA_DIR and isolated test runner separate databases; no formal development/staging/production deployment configuration.
